name: Garward Eastonton, Reformed Vessel

trait.name: Blooming Revelation
entries: When this phase begins, each creature of Garward's choice within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the end of Garward's next turn.

trait.name: Full Paragon
entries: Garward takes three turns each round, spaced evenly through initiative. He regains spent legendary actions only at the start of his first turn each round.

trait.name: Aura of Confession
entries: Creatures of Garward's choice within 30 feet of him have a -2 penalty to Wisdom saving throws.

trait.name: Psychic Smite
entries: Garward's weapon attacks deal an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
entries: If Garward fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Spellcasting
entries: Garward's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit +9} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following paladin spells prepared:
1st level (4 slots): {@spell bless}, {@spell command}, {@spell compelled duel}, {@spell shield of faith}
2nd level (3 slots): {@spell aid}, {@spell find steed}, {@spell hold person}, {@spell lesser restoration}
3rd level (3 slots): {@spell aura of vitality}, {@spell crusader's mantle}, {@spell revivify}
4th level (1 slot): {@spell banishment}, {@spell staggering smite}

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Garward makes two attacks, choosing from Longsword and Tentacles. He can replace one attack with Mind Lance.

action.name: Longsword
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: {@hit +9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) slashing damage, or 10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage.

action.name: Mind Lance
entries: Ranged Spell Attack: {@hit +9} to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage, and the target cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: {@hit +9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape {@dc 17}) and must succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or be stunned until this grapple ends.

action.name: Mind Blast ({@recharge 5})
entries: Garward magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. A stunned target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Extract Heresy
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: {@hit +9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated humanoid grappled by Garward. Hit: 55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, Garward kills the target by extracting and devouring its brain.

bonus.name: Lay on Hands
entries: Garward touches himself or another creature and restores up to 35 hit points from a pool.

reaction.name: Rebuke the Faithless
entries: When a creature Garward can see within 30 feet hits him with an attack, Garward forces the creature to make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

legendaryHeader: Garward can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time, and only at the end of another creature's turn. Garward regains spent legendary actions at the start of his first turn each round.

legendary.name: Commanding Step
entries: Garward moves up to half his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Sword of Office
entries: Garward makes one Longsword attack.

legendary.name: Psychic Rebuke
entries: One creature Garward can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Tentacular Drag (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: One creature grappled by Garward must succeed on a {@dc 17} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space Garward can see.

legendary.name: Break the Doctrine (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Garward recharges Mind Blast.
